name: PORT
summary: A 3D multiple object selection technique that allows users to select a group of objects in an immersive virtual environment using a spatial region-based interaction.
howItWorks: The user specifies a spatial selection region around the desired objects. Objects that fall within the defined region are selected as a group, reducing the need for repeated single-object selections.
advantages: Selecting multiple objects at once, especially when targets are grouped, clustered, or when selecting objects one by one would be inefficient.
limitations: The technique can become less precise when objects are densely packed or when intended and unintended objects are close to each other within the selection region.
